Officer's narrative
Responding officer was dispatched to a two-vehicle collision at an intersection in Pearland, Texas. Driver 1 stated
that while turning left, the front of Driver 2's vehicle struck the side of Driver 1's vehicle. Driver 1 reported a shoulder
injury and was evaluated at the scene. The nature of that injury is consistent with the type and force of a collision of
this kind. Driver 2, two independent witnesses, and scene photographs all support the account that the collision
occurred as Driver 1 described. The officer and witnesses also confirmed that Driver 1 was inside the vehicle at the
time. No prior damage to the veihcle is known. The damage visible on Driver 1's vehicle, however, is on a different
side than the one described as struck and sits at a different height from the reported point of impact. The officer noted
this discrepancy for follow-up. Driver 1 is listed as a named driver on the policy covering the vehicle.
</page>
